**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
I enclose the receipts and agreement with many thanks. I hope the [Primer](../books.html#353) is doing well.

One Blunder ought to be set right. I can’t help thinking it must have been a misprint. I knew it so well - ie that the Karling line had not died out - but been set aside.
I have done a good many correction to the [Christians & Moors](../books.html#126) and will finish them up when wanted.

As a matter of curiosity, what has [Mr Freeman](../persons.html#523) done with [France](../books.html#99)? I have kept all my old proofs for comparison when the book comes out.

Yours very truly

C M Yonge
